facts.fact: The Development Gateway diagnostic for UNICEF (September 2018, interviews in May 2018) states that the Ministry of Home Affairs oversees civil and vital registration using a National Identity and Civil Registry (NICR) database, of which it is the custodial agency, with collection ongoing by direct registration by ministry staff and with UNICEF support.
facts.system: National Identity and Civil Registry (NICR) database

facts.fact: The Development Gateway diagnostic for UNICEF (September 2018) states that the Ministry of Home Affairs is responsible for recording births and deaths of Lesotho citizens and oversees civil and vital registration processes using the NICR database; it does not say at which offices the entry is made.
facts.system: National Identity and Civil Registry (NICR) database
